code/python/src/category_theory/finite_c.purpose: Bounded immutable presentation and exact finite-category law checker, with total report-query factorization on a common source carrier.

operations.FiniteCategory: Admit a built-in frozenset and built-in dict tables with bounded built-in string labels and tuple endpoints; detach all state. A structurally admitted presentation can be law-invalid. Reinitialization and subclassing are refused; the object is unhashable.
operations.verify_axioms: Check endpoints, exact domain and codomain typing of composition, identities, both units and associativity. Return False for law-invalid presentations, including undeclared composites. The empty category is admitted.
operations.factor_report_query: Require nonempty built-in dicts with the same source set, exact bounded integer keys and values; return a detached decoder iff the query is constant on each report fibre.
operations.verify_report_query_factorization: Only CategoryLawError becomes (False, {}); unexpected infrastructure errors propagate.

code/python/src/category_theory/finite_c.policy: 64 objects, 64 morphisms, 4096 composition entries, labels at most 256 characters. Factor maps at most 4096 sources and integer labels at most 1024 bits. These are declared admission policies, not mathematical cardinality results.
code/python/src/category_theory/finite_c.failure: CategoryLawError for malformed containers, labels, endpoints representations, quotas, different carriers or conflicting fibres. Law-invalid but structurally admitted presentations return False. No caller dictionary alias remains in a committed category.
code/python/src/category_theory/finite_c.level_basis: Production API craft: admission is separate from law truth, owned immutable state commits after validation, exact composition typing and domain closure are checked, factor carriers are total and bounded, and typed refusals cover lifecycle and hostile ordinary value callbacks.
code/python/src/category_theory/finite_c.cost: For m arrows, at most O(m^3) associativity lookups and O(m^2) typing work, with m<=64. Factorization uses O(n) bounded exact entries/storage. Labels and integers have explicit size envelopes; no measured real-time guarantee.
code/python/src/category_theory/finite_c.ceiling: No classification of categories, free-category construction, general theorem prover or assertion that every query factors.
code/python/src/category_theory/finite_c.historical_finding: Captured witness accepts an undeclared ghost composite, ignores an extra query value and retains caller dictionary aliases.

code/python/src/category_theory/__init__.purpose: Checked two-object arrow and a compatible report decoder of size two, with a closed tuple-table public boundary.

operations.arrow_decoder_size: Defaults to the declared three-source report and query. Explicit nonempty tuple tables must have distinct source keys, share their carrier and yield exactly {10:1,20:0}. Check the fixed arrow category before returning 2.
operations.reexports: Expose the bounded backend types and factor operations under the same admission/trust policy.

code/python/src/category_theory/__init__.policy: At most 4096 tuple rows per table; each row is a built-in pair of built-in integers of at most 1024 bits. Reject duplicate sources before dict overwrite, including identical duplicate rows.
code/python/src/category_theory/__init__.failure: CategoryLawError with role context for container/arity/scalar/bit/source/duplicate failures or drift in the fixed arrow/decoder. Local quotas are checked before calling the factor provider.
code/python/src/category_theory/__init__.level_basis: A small production facade whose own typed admission, local preflight budgets, duplicate-preserving refusal and dependency composition are deliberately challenged; sophistication is in its reliable API boundary rather than in the fixed example.
code/python/src/category_theory/__init__.cost: O(n) bounded scalar admissions and table storage, plus the bounded backend factor operation. The category witness is constant size.
code/python/src/category_theory/__init__.ceiling: One fixed decoder image, not all finite categories or all report factorizations.
code/python/src/category_theory/__init__.historical_finding: Captured duplicate source rows silently overwrite an earlier value and still return the fixed decoder size.

code/python/src/category_theory/test_fin.purpose: Independent category/fibre controls and bounded source/self mutation checks for the declared finite arrow implementation.

operations.oracles: Compare the fixed arrow and factorization against explicit endpoint, unit, associativity and fibre checks; exercise invalid exact input admission.
operations.mutation_checks: Require a unique source replacement, distinguish semantic oracle rejection from candidate import/syntax/infrastructure refusal, and restore any earlier sys.modules binding.

code/python/src/category_theory/test_fin.policy: Fixed finite fixtures and fixed source replacement lists only. Temporary candidate modules live within the supplied test temporary directory. Test execution relies on the external challenge process deadline and captured logs.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_fin.failure: ClaimCheckError for expected semantic mismatches; malformed or unassessable candidates explicitly refuse and are not counted as kills. Unexpected oracle failures propagate. finally restores previous module bindings.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_fin.level_basis: Production checker lifecycle and outcome discipline, independently challenged at candidate admission, semantic oracle, infrastructure failure and import-state restoration boundaries.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_fin.cost: Fixed-size oracle arithmetic and one source copy/import per designated candidate; no input-sized search or claim of complete mutation-space coverage.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_fin.ceiling: Finite scoped checker assurance, not a kernel proof or exhaustive finite-category theorem.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_fin.historical_finding: Captured syntax-invalid source returned from the old mutation helper without refusal and was treated as killed.

code/python/src/category_theory/test_arr.purpose: Independent report-fibre decoder controls and honest source/self mutation checks for the fixed arrow facade.

operations.witnesses: Compute source count from the report domain and image count from distinct report values; compare the public decoder to the independent fibre oracle. Refusal witness actually runs the invalid scalar probe.
operations.mutation_checks: Only assessed semantic rejection counts as a kill; syntax/import or unexpected oracle failures refuse. Restore any prior module binding on every exit.

code/python/src/category_theory/test_arr.policy: Fixed three-source report and two-image decoder; bounded source replacement list. External challenge harness supplies process timeouts and retains all six outcome classes.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_arr.failure: Typed ClaimCheckError for mismatches; candidate-not-assessed refusal for infrastructure/syntax errors; unexpected oracle exceptions propagate.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_arr.level_basis: Reliable checker boundary with computed fixture statistics, independent fibre semantics, explicit candidate custody and import lifecycle handling; challenged against bogus values and false mutation accounting.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_arr.cost: Fixed finite report work and linear source-copy/import work per designated mutation; no unbounded enumeration.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_arr.ceiling: One fixed report-query example. The former literal 13 and 17 were not measurements and are explicitly superseded by computed values 3 and 2.
code/python/src/category_theory/test_arr.historical_finding: Captured source/image witnesses return 13 and 17 for a report with 3 sources and 2 images; invalid syntax was also counted as a kill.

code/python/src/functional/l1_seminorm.p.purpose: Exact rational weighted L1 quotient optimality checker with immutable verified context and explicit admission/work envelopes.

operations.admission: Built-in int, Fraction or integer ratio-pair only; built-in list/tuple vectors only. Normalize to owned tuples after size/type checks. Weights strictly positive, matrix rectangular; empty zero-dimensional presentation admitted.
operations.ExactPhi1Certificate: Unverified input DTO. Mutable or malformed list contents can be submitted, but this constructor grants no verified status.
operations.VerifiedExactPhi1: Every public construction validates all fields, primal identity, dual annihilation/box and closed primal-dual gap; optionally bind to an admitted immutable L1Seminorm. Own canonical tuples and return fresh mutable DTO/list copies to callers. No subclass or reinitialization bypass.
operations.evaluate_weighted_l1_quotient: Return the exact reported optimum only after presentation binding and the full certificate checks; no search/solver is supplied.

code/python/src/functional/l1_seminorm.p.policy: Vectors<=4096, coordinates<=256, boundary columns<=256, boundary entries<=16384, input integer/rational components<=1024 bits, accumulated arithmetic components<=8192 bits. Diagnostic role<=256 characters; vector role<=240 leaves index suffix space. Policies are engineering choices.
code/python/src/functional/l1_seminorm.p.failure: L1SeminormError with invariant and bounded role/shape/bit context. Refuse floats/subclasses/bool, zero denominator, oversized or inconsistent data, invalid witnesses and reinitialization. Only commit verified tuples after all checks. Arithmetic may create a temporary larger value before the work-bit refusal; no rounding.
code/python/src/functional/l1_seminorm.p.level_basis: Production certificate custody: raw submissions and verified results are distinct, every verified constructor checks the mathematics, contexts and exports detach caller state, and exact admission/shape/binding/work/lifecycle boundaries have independent adversarial controls.
code/python/src/functional/l1_seminorm.p.cost: O(n*k) rational work for primal and dual boundary checks plus O(n) optimality work and O(n*k) owned data. n<=256,k<=256, entries<=16384. Bit arithmetic and temporary growth are explicit; no peak-memory or wall-clock proof.
code/python/src/functional/l1_seminorm.p.ceiling: Conditional certificate of the declared weighted rational L1 optimum only. No solver completeness, MSS derivation, choice of L1 over rivals, Gamma2, R_cl, Born uniqueness, Lean extraction or authority promotion.
code/python/src/functional/l1_seminorm.p.historical_finding: Captured public verified constructor accepts invalid data; mutating submitted omega changes a verified context without its value, and Fraction subclass arithmetic executes an unadmitted float operation.

code/python/src/functional/__init__.py.purpose: Bounded exact two-row zero-quotient witness facade and checked reexports of the L1 certificate API.

operations.exported_zero_phi1: Default column (1,-1), weights (1,1). Explicit inputs are two pairs each: column padding entries must vanish and repeated positive weights must agree within each pair. Build the zero primal-dual certificate and run the bound backend checker.
operations.reexports: Expose the repaired exact certificate API without bypassing backend verification.

code/python/src/functional/__init__.py.policy: Only built-in tuples of two built-in integer pairs; each integer<=1024 bits. Validate the local row and scalar boundary before any delegated certificate provider.
code/python/src/functional/__init__.py.failure: L1SeminormError for shape/type/bit/padding/repeated-weight failures and all provider certificate refusals. No float, subclass arithmetic or external mutable verified context is admitted.
code/python/src/functional/__init__.py.level_basis: A closed production facade with explicit shape/bit/refusal contracts and preflight separation from its provider, tested for callback refusal and resource-budget enforcement before delegation.
code/python/src/functional/__init__.py.cost: Fixed two-row admission plus a constant-size exact certificate check; copied owned data is fixed size.
code/python/src/functional/__init__.py.ceiling: Zero residual certificate only. Does not choose the seminorm, derive quantum theory or grant authority.
code/python/src/functional/__init__.py.historical_finding: Earlier facade snapshot retained as unassessed dependency context; backend failures do not automatically establish a separate executed facade counterexample.

code/python/src/functional/test_exported.purpose: Independent zero primal-dual oracle with computed fixture witnesses and honest source/self mutation accounting.

operations.oracles: Compute zero primal residual/dual feasibility/cost independently of the public facade; derive row-count and weight witnesses from declared fixtures and run the guard rejection probe.
operations.mutation_checks: Unique source replacement and assessed semantic rejection required; invalid import/syntax refuses without a kill. Unexpected infrastructure failures propagate and previous sys.modules bindings are restored.

code/python/src/functional/test_exported.policy: Fixed two-coordinate fixture and finite source replacement lists. External challenge harness provides captured process deadlines and six-outcome reporting.
code/python/src/functional/test_exported.failure: ClaimCheckError for semantic mismatches; typed unassessable-candidate refusal for syntax/import problems. Only expected semantic exceptions count toward oracle rejection; finally restores imports.
code/python/src/functional/test_exported.level_basis: Production checker lifecycle and epistemic integrity with independent arithmetic, fixture-derived values, explicit candidate admission and challenged restoration/refusal behavior.
code/python/src/functional/test_exported.cost: Fixed rational oracle operations plus linear copied-source/import work per named candidate. No exhaustive verification or independent alternate checker claim.
code/python/src/functional/test_exported.ceiling: One zero witness. No derivation of L1, general optimality solver or inherited Lean kernel receipt.
code/python/src/functional/test_exported.historical_finding: Inspection of captured old source finds blanket candidate/import and oracle exception handling; no separately executed historical failure is asserted for this file.
